newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian police say may have found serial killer.
newsitem.headline: Estonian police say may have found serial killer.

text.p: Estonian police said on Tuesday they are holding a man who may be a suspected serial killer who has terrorised the northeastern town of Narva.
Four women were killed and one seriously injured in attacks in the Russian-dominated town of 80,000 over the last month.
Police said they have arrested a 21-year-old unemployed man in connection with an attack last month, when the woman was brutally beaten and died soon after being taken to hospital.
"We have strong charges against him on this one count and are checking to see if it is related to the other four cases," a police spokesman told Reuters.
"The murders seem to have been carried out in a similar way but we cannot be sure yet," the spokesman added.
All of the women, aged between 17 and 27, were beaten, and were left naked or just partially clothed. One victim had her ear-rings torn off and a noose made from a stocking tied around her neck.
